title: vitex agnus-castus var. negundo
intro: Vitex agnus-castus var. negundo, commonly known as Vitex negundo, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can help alleviate menstrual cramps, anxiety, and stress. The therapeutic actions of Vitex negundo include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve digestion, and exhibit adaptogenic properties. The bioactive constituents of Vitex negundo include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
